IS 1784 : 2020 Screwed Closures for Drums-Specification
ICS 55.140
PGD 38
Revised Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of tests for steel and zinc alloy closures used on drums of nominal capacity of 200 litres with fixed ends [see IS 1783 (Part 1 and 2)].
1.2 Two nominal sizes of closures, 50 mm and 20 mm have been covered in this standard.
2 REFERENCES
